title: In old Madrid
html_source:
A popular song from ca 1889. (Sheet music)

Sheet music for this song is visible in the photo of Molly that Bloom shows Stephen at the cabman’s shelter (Eumaeus episode), which pictures her “standing near, ostensibly with gravity, a piano on the rest of which was In Old Madrid, a ballad, pretty in its way, which was then all the vogue.”
